notes: No single official policy-review checklist for the Texas HCS residential program (Supervised Living / Residential Support Services in three- and four-person residences) is identified in the supplied research, and I did not use tools to open any document. Because the item text and numbering could not be confirmed from a source, I have not listed any required policy items; doing so would risk inventing them. Next steps: (1) open the CAPM 'How to Apply' PDF and the CAMP provisional-contract application materials to see whether they contain a policy or plan-of-operation checklist; (2) if they do not, extract the 'program provider must have written policies and procedures' provisions from 26 TAC Ch. 565 (starting with §565.7/§565.9, then §565.13, §565.23, §565.27) and from 26 TAC Ch. 263 (§263.502), keeping each provision's own subsection numbering (for example 'A(7)' or 'B9') as the item_id and cite; (3) for a four-person residence, add the §565.41/§565.43 approval requirements and the fire marshal inspection. Expected submission: electronically through the HHSC CAMP portal for the provisional contract, followed by the Pre-Award Training (PAT) exam request and a later LTCR certification survey. Organization of the manual should follow the Ch. 565 section order once the items are extracted, since there is no verified checklist section order to mirror.
